'''Bestinnian tang-root''' was a kind of strong smelling [[Plant/Legends|root]] that could be eaten by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and served on [[bhillen sandwich]]es.<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the young Human [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Shannon Voorson]] prepared a bhillen sandwich with Bestinnian tang-root as part of a plan to run away and join her cousin, [[Deen Voorson]], in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Shannon placed the sandwich in a [[thermabag]] along with a [[signaller]], hoping that the smell of the tang-root would discourage discovery of the communication device.<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bestinnian tang-root first appeared in "[[Slaying Dragons]]," a [[1996]] short story written by [[Angela Phillips]] published by [[West End Games]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''.<ref name="Slaying Dragons" />
